name: Ring of the Ram
description: A heavy ring of beaten brass shaped like a ram's head.
body:
## What it does

It holds three charges and regains 1d3 each dawn. As an action, spend one to three to hurl a spectral ram's head at a creature within 60 feet. The ring attacks with +7: a hit deals 2d10 force damage for each charge spent and pushes the creature 5 feet away for each. Or spend one to three to try to break an object you can see within 60 feet that nobody wears or carries, with a Strength check of +5 for each charge.

features.name: Ram
features.text: 1 to 3 charges: a ranged attack at +7 against a creature within 60 feet, dealing 2d10 force damage and pushing it 5 feet per charge.
